frequency_intercept_delay_model.interpretation: Effective RX1-minus-RX2 electrical group delay at the common reference gain.
frequency_intercept_delay_model.phase_unwrap_assumption: Adjacent measured frequencies differ by less than 180 degrees of true unwrapped phase.
frequency_intercept_delay_model.warning: Descriptive only: cables, PCB and analogue paths, LO retunes, and calibration state can all contribute. It is not asserted to be literal cable length.

additive_vs_cell_interaction.recommendation_reason: MAE difference is inside the predeclared practical-equivalence margin

additive_vs_gain_difference_only.recommendation_reason: lower held-out MAE outside equivalence margin

model_comparisons.anchor_policy: One held-out equal-gain frame per frequency/epoch; anchor frame excluded from scoring.

frequency_specific_vs_gain_table_shared_.boundary_membership: start < frequency <= end; 1.3 GHz is low-table and 4.0 GHz is middle-table
